summary: Cold iteration-1 codegen: 21 Java files, two controllers (GasAnalysisController, MovementController), all 81 requirements traced. 12 review items: invented defaults and design choices, none blocking.

issues.title: Configuration constant values
issues.raw: The requirements say thr, lv, evadeTime, stuckPeriod, stuckDist and outPeriod are configured at start-up but give no values.
issues.fix_directive: Chose small integer-valued defaults (THR=3.0, LV=1.0, EVADE_TIME=1, STUCK_PERIOD=3, STUCK_DIST=1.0, OUT_PERIOD=2) in the platform time unit. Replace with the deployment values.

issues.title: What 'a reading indicates the target chemical' means
issues.raw: CD-Fn1 does not define when a GasSensor value indicates the target chemical.
issues.fix_directive: analysis() returns gasD iff some sample has c equal to the configured target Chem and intensity > 0.

issues.title: Sensor position to Angle mapping, empty-reading defaults
issues.raw: CD-DM7/CD-Fn3 say position maps to a sensing direction but not which. Fn2/Fn3 have a non-empty precondition.
issues.fix_directive: angle(x) follows Angle declaration order (1=Left, 2=Right, 3=Back, 4=Front, repeating). Ties pick the first peak. Empty reading: intensity 0.0, location Front.

issues.title: Peak intensity is taken over all chemicals
issues.raw: CD-Fn2's postcondition (result >= every i in the input) makes intensity the maximum over every sample, including non-target chemicals, so a strong non-target reading can reach thr once the target is merely present.
issues.fix_directive: Implemented literally as the spec states. Confirm whether intensity should range over target-chemical samples only.

issues.title: Gas-analysis terminal state is 'Concluded', not a RoboChart final state
issues.raw: CD-GA-Beh6 says the subsystem concludes and processes no further readings; the codegen rules require every mode to have an outgoing transition.
issues.fix_directive: Concluded self-loops on gas, retaining the reading in gs (CD-GA-Var1) without analysing it or emitting anything. This is one extra transition beyond the 7 GA behaviours listed in CD-DC1.

issues.title: Found stays halted via a silent self-loop on stop
issues.raw: CD-MV-Beh9 (Found_to_Final) now says Found stays halted; every mode needs an outgoing transition, and the flag must be emitted once.
issues.fix_directive: Found self-loops on stop with no action. The flag + move(0, Front) are actions on each incoming stop transition, so a repeated stop never re-emits flag.

issues.title: Odometer is a sampled sensor value, not an input event
issues.raw: CD-Evt3 calls the odometer an event but the movement subsystem only samples it on entry to Avoiding and on the TryingAgain->AvoidingAgain transition.
issues.fix_directive: OdometerSensor.odometer() is read into d0/d1; the platform updates it via update(). No odometer InputEvent exists.

issues.title: Waiting's during randomWalk() runs at the head of the mode block
issues.raw: CD-MV-FR1 specifies a during action; the step() pattern has no during construct.
issues.fix_directive: vehicle.randomWalk() is the first statement of the Waiting block, so it runs every cycle spent in Waiting.

issues.title: Guards written as complementary pairs
issues.raw: Analysis guards on sts, GasDetected on ins vs thr, AvoidingAgain on progress vs stuck.
issues.fix_directive: Each pair is p / !p (stsIsNoGas, insAtOrAboveThr, withinStuckPeriod||advancedBeyondStuckDist). !stsIsNoGas equals sts == gasD for the two-valued Status. The threshold guard uses ins >= THR directly; goreq() is implemented and used inside intensity/location.

issues.title: Type representations
issues.raw: Chem (opaque), Intensity (ordered) and the GasSensor record need Java types.
issues.fix_directive: Chem is a record wrapping a nat id; Intensity is double (real). The GasSensor record is named GasSample so it is not mistaken for a sensor-service class.

issues.title: Operations: platform methods vs operation class
issues.raw: Four operation requirements; move/randomWalk/shortRandomWalk are provided by the Vehicle, changeDirection is local.
issues.fix_directive: move/randomWalk/shortRandomWalk (and pause, for wait) are Vehicle methods. changeDirection is operation.ChangeDirection. None needs a compute() because none computes state variables.

issues.title: System wiring class
issues.raw: CD-ARCH2 needs the two subsystems connected by turn/stop/resume.
issues.fix_directive: ChemicalDetectorSystem routes Vehicle events and forwards gas-analysis outputs to movement. Before delivering each event it runs one no-event cycle, so AvoidingAgain resolves before a turn arrives and the turn is not lost.

next_step: Run the pipeline; review the invented defaults and the Concluded/Found terminal-state choices.
